claims.text: The hotel is located on the Magnificent Mile within Water Tower Place.

findings.quote: Located on the Magnificent Mile within the landmark Water Tower Place, this luxury hotel in downtown Chicago near Navy Pier

claims.text: The Presidential Suite spans two floors and about 2,900 square feet, with views of Lake Michigan and the city skyline.

findings.quote: Encompassing two floors, the Presidential Suite spans 2,900 square feet and offers a taste of luxury living. Upon entering the room, guests are greeted by unparalleled views of Lake Michigan and the city’s skyline.

claims.text: Skyline Suites are on the 30th floor and have a galley kitchen and a dining table for eight.

findings.quote: On the 30th floor, the 1,000 square foot Skyline Suites resides and offers apartment-style living with a galley kitchen and a dining table for eight.

claims.text: Even the smallest rooms have a sofa and desk beside the picture windows.

findings.quote: even the smallest ones have a sofa and desk beside the picture windows

claims.text: The Club Lounge offers five food and beverage presentations each day.

findings.quote: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

claims.text: Rooftop at Torali is a rooftop bar on the 12th floor with city and lake views.

findings.quote: Enjoy city and lake views from the 12th floor at Rooftop at Torali. Our rooftop bar in downtown Chicago

claims.text: The Café is a greenhouse-inspired rooftop bar serving specialty coffees, pastries and desserts.

findings.quote: This greenhouse-inspired rooftop bar in downtown Chicago is perfect for enjoying specialty coffees, fresh juices, sandwiches, pastries, and decadent desserts served daily.

claims.text: The fitness center has Peloton exercise bikes and Woodway treadmills.

findings.quote: state-of-the-art fitness equipment, including Peloton® Exercise Bikes and Woodway Treadmills.

claims.text: The pool is a lap pool topped by a glass atrium.

findings.quote: 52’ lap pool topped by a glass atrium, providing natural light throughout the year.

claims.text: The spa offers massage, facial and body treatments.

findings.quote: It features an extensive offering of massage, facial, and body treatments.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a media room, a wet bar and a full-service kitchen.

findings.quote: Other highlights include a media room, a wet bar, two bathrooms and a guest powder room.
The full-service kitchen, island and spacious dining area are perfect for entertaining.

claims.text: The Chef's Presidential Tasting Journey is a caviar and champagne tasting led by Executive Chef Damion Henry in the Presidential Suite.

findings.quote: Indulge in an intimate caviar and champagne tasting led by Executive Chef Damion Henry in the refined elegance of The Ritz-Carlton, Chicago’s Presidential Suite.

claims.text: The Unexpected Vineyard experience flies guests by private helicopter to a Michigan vineyard for a tasting and lunch.

findings.quote: Soar from Chicago by private helicopter to a curated Michigan vineyard for an exclusive tasting, lunch, and same-day return with an elegant dinner finale.

claims.text: Children are greeted on arrival with a red wagon from which they can pick a toy to take home.

findings.quote: Ritz Kids are greeted by our Ladies and Gentlemen with the Red Wagon upon arrival and can pick their toy of choice to take home with them as a souvenir from their visit to Chicago.

claims.text: The art collection celebrates Chicago's steel skyline and the waters of Lake Michigan.

findings.quote: Chicago’s famed steel skyline and surrounding waters of Lake Michigan are celebrated throughout the spaces.

claims.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not include complimentary Club access.

findings.quote: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

claims.text: Wi-Fi is not complimentary unless you are a Marriott Bonvoy member.

findings.quote: Good Wi-Fi, but it's not complimentary unless you are a Marriott Bonvoy member

claims.text: Rooftop at Torali is open seasonally.
